cohort: The cohort included Kaiser Permanente Southern California (KPSC) health plan members who gave birth at >=20 weeks' gestation in a KPSC-owned hospital during 2008-2017.
finding: SMM rates increased from 2008-2017, and non-Hispanic Black, Asian/Pacific Islander, and Hispanic women had a greater likelihood of experiencing an SMM event compared to non-Hispanic White women, even after adjusting for maternal demographics, pregnancy characteristics, and preexisting conditions.
